title: Concrete masonry unit plus finishes.
officialText:
The equivalent thickness of concrete masonry assemblies,
T ea, shall be computed as the sum of the equivalent thickness of the concrete masonry unit, T , as determined by
e
Section 721.3.1.2, 721.3.1.3, or 721.3.1.4, plus the equivalent thickness of finishes, T , determined in accordance
ef
with Section 721.3.2:
T = T + T (Equation 7-6)
ea e ef
